# Specification and convention references

## [docs/conventions/Algebra.md](../conventions/Algebra.md) — Algebra conventions (page)

- `AlgebraElement(algebra::FiniteAlgebra, coefficients_or_index) -> AlgebraElement` — Return a coordinate element of the supplied finite-dimensional algebra. [contract](algebra/AlgebraElement.md)
- `FiniteAlgebra(dimension, multiplication, unit, name) -> FiniteAlgebra` — Store multiplication and unit data for a finite-dimensional algebra in a chosen basis. [contract](algebra/FiniteAlgebra.md)
- `FiniteHopfAlgebra(dimension, multiplication, unit, coproduct, …) -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Store finite-dimensional Hopf-algebra tensor data without validating the axioms. [contract](algebra/FiniteHopfAlgebra.md)
- `SparseFactor(variables, terms::AbstractDict) -> SparseFactor` — Store coefficients and index labels of a sparse tensor. [contract](algebra/SparseFactor.md)
- `SymExpr(text::String) -> SymExpr` — Store formal expression text for the lightweight symbolic operations. [contract](algebra/SymExpr.md)
- `Z_Kuperberg(x, algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra; …) -> ComplexF64` — Return the normalized Kuperberg coordinate contraction of the supplied Heegaard presentation. [contract](heegaard-code/Z_Kuperberg.md)
- `basis_element(algebra::FiniteAlgebra, index::Integer) -> AlgebraElement` — Return the indicated basis element of a finite algebra or the algebra underlying a Hopf algebra. [contract](algebra/basis_element.md)
- `basis_element(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra, index::Integer) -> AlgebraElement` — Return the indicated basis element of the algebra underlying a Hopf algebra. [contract](algebra/basis_element.md)
- `contract_network(factors, outputs = Int[]) -> SparseFactor` — Return the contraction of a labelled sparse tensor network with the requested free indices. [contract](algebra/contract_network.md)
- `cyclic_group_algebra(order::Integer) -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Return exact structure tensors for the group Hopf algebra of a cyclic group. [contract](algebra/cyclic_group_algebra.md)
- `dense_tensor(factor::SparseFactor{T}, dimension::Integer) -> Array` — Return a dense coefficient array for a labelled sparse tensor. [contract](algebra/dense_tensor.md)
- `drinfeld_double(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> FiniteAlgebra` — Return the repository's Drinfeld-double product data on the dual/primal tensor-product space. [contract](algebra/drinfeld_double.md)
- `dual_algebra(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Return tensor data for the linear dual of a finite-dimensional Hopf algebra. [contract](algebra/dual_algebra.md)
- `evaluate_tensor_expression(expression::AbstractString, tensors::AbstractDict, outputs = Int[]; …) -> SparseFactor` — Evaluate a named tensor expression as a sparse coordinate contraction. [contract](algebra/evaluate_tensor_expression.md)
- `exterior_algebra(generator_count::Integer) -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Return the library's finite exterior-algebra model with its graded Hopf tensors. [contract](algebra/exterior_algebra.md)
- `group_algebra(elements::AbstractVector, multiply) -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Return exact group Hopf tensors for a finite group supplied by ordered elements and a product. [contract](algebra/group_algebra.md)
- `group_algebra(table::AbstractMatrix{<:Integer}) -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Return exact structure tensors for the Hopf algebra of a finite group supplied by its multiplication table. [contract](algebra/group_algebra.md)
- `heisenberg_double(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> FiniteAlgebra` — Return the repository's Heisenberg-double product data on the dual/primal tensor-product space. [contract](algebra/heisenberg_double.md)
- `hopf_invariant(v::VirtualLink, H::FiniteHopfAlgebra{TaftKind{N, M, S}}; …) -> Any` — Evaluate a closed o-graph with tagged finite Taft data through the applicable exact or numeric route. [contract](o-graph/hopf_invariant.md)
- `hopf_invariant(v::VirtualLink, H::TaftAlgebra; …) -> Union{Cyclotomic,NamedTuple,TaftExpression}` — Return the exact or symbolic Taft contraction of a closed o-graph. [contract](o-graph/hopf_invariant.md)
- `hopf_invariant(v::VirtualLink, algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra; …) -> Any` — Evaluate the repository's closed o-graph tensor contraction with the supplied Hopf-algebra data. [contract](o-graph/hopf_invariant.md)
- `hopf_invariant(v::VirtualLink, ratio::Rational; …) -> Union{Cyclotomic,NamedTuple}` — Evaluate the closed o-graph Taft contraction at the primitive root specified by a rational parameter. [contract](o-graph/hopf_invariant.md)
- `hopf_pairing(dual::AlgebraElement, primal::AlgebraElement) -> ComplexF64` — Return the bilinear coordinate pairing of a dual element with a primal element. [contract](algebra/hopf_pairing.md)
- `hopf_tensors(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> Dict{String,SparseFactor}` — Return the structure-tensor dictionary used for contractions of a finite Hopf algebra. [contract](algebra/hopf_tensors.md)
- `is_involutory(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra; …) -> Bool` — Numerically test involutivity of the stored antipode on the algebra's coordinate space. [contract](algebra/is_involutory.md)
- `is_unimodular(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra; …) -> Bool` — Numerically compare the lines represented by the stored left and right integral vectors. [contract](algebra/is_unimodular.md)
- `kac_paljutkin_algebra() -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Return the library's eight-dimensional Kac–Paljutkin tensor model with numerical distinguished tensors. [contract](algebra/kac_paljutkin_algebra.md)
- `label_tensor(tensor::SparseFactor, labels) -> SparseFactor` — Return a labelled coordinate tensor with repeated labels restricted to their common diagonal. [contract](algebra/label_tensor.md)
- `legacy_hopf_tensors(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> Dict{String,SparseFactor}` — Return Hopf-coordinate tensors for the legacy C250406 tensor-expression interface. [contract](algebra/legacy_hopf_tensors.md)
- `sweedler_algebra() -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Return the library's four-dimensional Sweedler Hopf-algebra model. [contract](algebra/sweedler_algebra.md)
- `sym(x::AbstractString) -> SymExpr` — Return formal expression text from a string. [contract](algebra/sym.md)
- `sym(x::Number) -> SymExpr` — Return the textual symbolic form of a number. [contract](algebra/sym.md)
- `sym(x::SymExpr) -> SymExpr` — Return a textual symbolic expression for the supplied value. [contract](algebra/sym.md)
- `sym(x::Symbol) -> SymExpr` — Return formal expression text for a symbol. [contract](algebra/sym.md)
- `taft_evaluate(reduced, N::Integer; …) -> Cyclotomic` — Evaluate a symbolic Taft contraction exactly at a specified primitive root. [contract](algebra/taft_evaluate.md)
- `taft_reduce(v::VirtualLink; …) -> TaftExpression` — Return a symbolic finite-sum expression for the closed o-graph's Taft contraction. [contract](o-graph/taft_reduce.md)
- `uqsl2_borel_small(ratio::Rational; …) -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Return the library's small Borel tensor model at the rational root parameter. [contract](algebra/uqsl2_borel_small.md)
- `validate_tensor_expression(expression::AbstractString, outputs = Int[]; …) -> Vector{String}` — Return syntax, index and optional tensor-rank diagnostics for a coordinate tensor expression. [contract](algebra/validate_tensor_expression.md)
- `verify_hopf(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra; …) -> Dict{String,Bool}` — Return coordinate checks of the named Hopf identities for the supplied structural tensors. [contract](algebra/verify_hopf.md)

- `compose_dilation!(d::URDiagram, pair; …) -> URDiagram` — Compose a selected pair of adjacent U(R) dilation edges into one edge. [contract](ur-diagram/compose_dilation!.md)
- `delete_edge!(d::URDiagram, edge::Integer) -> URDiagram` — Remove one edge and its two endpoint labels from a weighted U(R) diagram. [contract](ur-diagram/delete_edge!.md)
- `dilation!(d::URDiagram, dil::Integer, arg::Integer; …) -> URDiagram` — Move a selected signed endpoint across a U(R) dilation pair and update its edge weight. [contract](ur-diagram/dilation!.md)
- `odata(d::URDiagram) -> String` — Render a unit-weight U(R) diagram as its source-format O-data word. [contract](ur-diagram/odata.md)
- `set_data_cvs!(d::URDiagram, C, V, S; …) -> URDiagram` — Replace a U(R) diagram's data with weights perturbed by supplied or formal epsilon values. [contract](ur-diagram/set_data_cvs!.md)
- `set_data_cvw!(d::URDiagram, C, V, W) -> URDiagram` — Replace a U(R) diagram's coefficient, vertex word and weights and rebuild its edge table. [contract](ur-diagram/set_data_cvw!.md)
- `set_data_v!(d::URDiagram, V) -> URDiagram` — Set a U(R) diagram's vertex word with unspecified numeric weights. [contract](ur-diagram/set_data_v!.md)
- `simplify!(d::URDiagram; …) -> URDiagram` — Reduce a weighted U(R) diagram using the multi-rank reduction contract. [contract](ur-diagram/simplify!.md)
- `simplify1!(d::URDiagram; …) -> URDiagram` — Apply the rank-one U(R) diagram reduction routine with an iteration bound. [contract](ur-diagram/simplify1!.md)
- `simplify2!(d::URDiagram; …) -> URDiagram` — Apply the multi-rank U(R) diagram reduction routine with an iteration bound. [contract](ur-diagram/simplify2!.md)
- `swap!(d::URDiagram, pair; …) -> URDiagram` — Apply the selected endpoint interchange to a weighted U(R) diagram. [contract](ur-diagram/swap!.md)
- `trace1(d::URDiagram) -> Any` — Evaluate the unregularized single-edge U(R) trace expression. [contract](ur-diagram/trace1.md)
- `trace2(d::URDiagram) -> Any` — Evaluate the unregularized matrix-trace expression assigned to a U(R) diagram. [contract](ur-diagram/trace2.md)
- `trace3(d::URDiagram) -> Any` — Evaluate the rank-one block-matrix U(R) trace expression. [contract](ur-diagram/trace3.md)
- `trace_value(d::URDiagram) -> Any` — Return the U(R) matrix-trace expression after reducing the supplied diagram in place. [contract](ur-diagram/trace_value.md)
- `trans_knot_complement(code) -> Vector{Int}` — Return the U(R) endpoint word assigned by the repository's knot-complement conversion recipe. [contract](ur-diagram/trans_knot_complement.md)
- `unicode_art(d::URDiagram) -> String` — Return a textual diagnostic of a weighted U(R) diagram. [contract](ur-diagram/unicode_art.md)
- `validate_data(d::URDiagram) -> Bool` — Check the supported structural consistency conditions of a weighted U(R) diagram. [contract](ur-diagram/validate_data.md)
- `weight_expression(d::URDiagram) -> String` — Render the U(R) diagram's endpoint word as a formal word of weighted-operator labels. [contract](ur-diagram/weight_expression.md)

## [docs/specs/algebra.md#definitions](../specs/algebra.md#definitions) — Definitions

- `AlgebraElement(algebra::FiniteAlgebra, coefficients_or_index) -> AlgebraElement` — Return a coordinate element of the supplied finite-dimensional algebra. [contract](algebra/AlgebraElement.md)
- `FiniteAlgebra(dimension, multiplication, unit, name) -> FiniteAlgebra` — Store multiplication and unit data for a finite-dimensional algebra in a chosen basis. [contract](algebra/FiniteAlgebra.md)
- `FiniteHopfAlgebra(dimension, multiplication, unit, coproduct, …) -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Store finite-dimensional Hopf-algebra tensor data without validating the axioms. [contract](algebra/FiniteHopfAlgebra.md)
- `SparseFactor(variables, terms::AbstractDict) -> SparseFactor` — Store coefficients and index labels of a sparse tensor. [contract](algebra/SparseFactor.md)
- `SymExpr(text::String) -> SymExpr` — Store formal expression text for the lightweight symbolic operations. [contract](algebra/SymExpr.md)
- `basis_element(algebra::FiniteAlgebra, index::Integer) -> AlgebraElement` — Return the indicated basis element of a finite algebra or the algebra underlying a Hopf algebra. [contract](algebra/basis_element.md)
- `basis_element(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra, index::Integer) -> AlgebraElement` — Return the indicated basis element of the algebra underlying a Hopf algebra. [contract](algebra/basis_element.md)
- `contract_network(factors, outputs = Int[]) -> SparseFactor` — Return the contraction of a labelled sparse tensor network with the requested free indices. [contract](algebra/contract_network.md)
- `dense_tensor(factor::SparseFactor{T}, dimension::Integer) -> Array` — Return a dense coefficient array for a labelled sparse tensor. [contract](algebra/dense_tensor.md)
- `drinfeld_double(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> FiniteAlgebra` — Return the repository's Drinfeld-double product data on the dual/primal tensor-product space. [contract](algebra/drinfeld_double.md)
- `dual_algebra(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Return tensor data for the linear dual of a finite-dimensional Hopf algebra. [contract](algebra/dual_algebra.md)
- `group_algebra(table::AbstractMatrix{<:Integer}) -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Return exact structure tensors for the Hopf algebra of a finite group supplied by its multiplication table. [contract](algebra/group_algebra.md)
- `heisenberg_double(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> FiniteAlgebra` — Return the repository's Heisenberg-double product data on the dual/primal tensor-product space. [contract](algebra/heisenberg_double.md)
- `hopf_pairing(dual::AlgebraElement, primal::AlgebraElement) -> ComplexF64` — Return the bilinear coordinate pairing of a dual element with a primal element. [contract](algebra/hopf_pairing.md)
- `hopf_tensors(algebra::FiniteHopfAlgebra) -> Dict{String,SparseFactor}` — Return the structure-tensor dictionary used for contractions of a finite Hopf algebra. [contract](algebra/hopf_tensors.md)
- `label_tensor(tensor::SparseFactor, labels) -> SparseFactor` — Return a labelled coordinate tensor with repeated labels restricted to their common diagonal. [contract](algebra/label_tensor.md)
- `sweedler_algebra() -> FiniteHopfAlgebra` — Return the library's four-dimensional Sweedler Hopf-algebra model. [contract](algebra/sweedler_algebra.md)
- `sym(x::AbstractString) -> SymExpr` — Return formal expression text from a string. [contract](algebra/sym.md)
- `sym(x::Number) -> SymExpr` — Return the textual symbolic form of a number. [contract](algebra/sym.md)

## [docs/specs/virtual-link-data-model.md](../specs/virtual-link-data-model.md) — VirtualLink multi-representation data-model rationale (page)

- `VirtualLink(; …) -> VirtualLink` — Create empty mutable storage for a virtual-link presentation. [contract](o-graph/VirtualLink.md)
- `VirtualLink(g, o, w, r, …) -> VirtualLink` — Construct integer-mode presentation storage from the six historical fields. [contract](o-graph/VirtualLink.md)
- `VirtualLink(gauss, orientation, weights, real_only, …) -> VirtualLink` — Create mutable storage for a virtual-link or o-graph presentation. [contract](o-graph/VirtualLink.md)
- `framed_lens_space_input(p::Integer, q::Integer) -> NamedTuple` — Return the deterministic integer-weighted normal o-graph presentation of the framed lens-space family. [contract](lens-space/framed_lens_space_input.md)
- `knot_complement!(v::VirtualLink) -> VirtualLink` — Return the version-2 combinatorial expansion associated with the knot-complement construction. [contract](o-graph/knot_complement!.md)
- `lens_space_rgauss(s::Integer, t::Integer) -> NamedTuple` — Return the real-Gauss data of the repository's parameterized lens-space presentation. [contract](o-graph/lens_space_rgauss.md)
- `movable(v::VirtualLink, type; …) -> Vector{MoveCandidate}` — Return supported local move candidates for a VirtualLink in its current weight mode. [contract](heegaard-code/Topology.MoveAPI.movable.md)
- `ograph_raw_hash(link::VirtualLink) -> String` — Return the replay fingerprint of a link's ordered real-Gauss projection. [contract](o-graph/ograph_raw_hash.md)
- `ograph_search_candidates(link::VirtualLink, move_kind::AbstractString; …) -> Vector{MoveCandidate}` — Enumerate selected unweighted local move candidates on a virtual-link presentation. [contract](o-graph/ograph_search_candidates.md)
- `ograph_search_state(link::VirtualLink) -> CanonicalState` — Return the unweighted exact-presentation descriptor used as a geometric search vertex. [contract](o-graph/ograph_search_state.md)
- `pd_code(v::VirtualLink) -> Matrix{Int}` — Return the four-slot PD presentation of the stored virtual-link diagram. [contract](o-graph/pd_code.md)
- `put_ograph_search_state!(store::MoveGraphStoreDB, link::VirtualLink) -> CanonicalState` — Persist the unweighted exact presentation used as an o-graph search vertex. [contract](move-graph/put_ograph_search_state!.md)
- `real_edge_table(v::VirtualLink) -> Vector{RealEdge}` — Return the directed real arcs of a virtual-link presentation in traversal order. [contract](o-graph/real_edge_table.md)
- `real_gauss_code(v::VirtualLink) -> Tuple{Vector{Vector{Int}},Vector{Int}}` — Return the real-crossing Gauss presentation and its vertex signs. [contract](o-graph/real_gauss_code.md)
- `regions(pd::AbstractMatrix{<:Integer}) -> Vector{Vector{Int}}` — Return the signed face-boundary walks of a closed PD rotation system. [contract](o-graph/regions.md)
- `search_state(x::Union{HeegaardCode, VirtualLink}; …) -> CanonicalState` — Return the presentation-specific identity record used as a search vertex. [contract](heegaard-code/search_state.md)
- `set_data!(v::VirtualLink; …) -> VirtualLink` — Replace a link's stored presentation from one supported input representation. [contract](o-graph/set_data!.md)
- `ur_invariant(v::VirtualLink) -> Any` — Return the legacy symbolic trace of the link's UR-diagram projection. [contract](o-graph/ur_invariant.md)
- `ur_prime_invariant(v::VirtualLink) -> Rational{BigInt}` — Return the exact U(R) MST trace value of a link's real-Gauss presentation. [contract](o-graph/ur_prime_invariant.md)
- `vl_to_urdiagram(v::VirtualLink) -> URDiagram` — Return the legacy U(R) diagram associated with a link's real-Gauss projection. [contract](o-graph/vl_to_urdiagram.md)
